content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 22.1 (p0093) allowed Vendor to audit "at any time without notice" with remote access to our systems — walk-away territory and inconsistent with the protective § 22.2. I proposed a single surgical replacement of that sentence carrying the preferred limits (once per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, business hours, off-site where possible, independent auditor bound by confidentiality) and deleting the remote-access grant. The already-compliant § 22.2 protections (Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent; no direct system access) were left verbatim and mapped as already met.
